## REQ-BUS-001

**Publishing may start once the request topics are subscribed**

At startup, a component subscribes to the topics on which a reaction is expected from it (Get, Set, Del of its resources, Call of its common services); once this is done, it may start publishing.

- Keyword: MAY
- Levels: L1 MAY · L2 MAY · L3 MAY
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 9.1
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1-49193b6c

> Once subscribing to the topics is done, Service A may start publishing.
> — MG 9.1

Notes: The first publication after connect is the Birth message (REQ-LIFE-015). Messages without subscriber are lost (no retained messages, REQ-MQTT-018).

## REQ-BUS-002

**A requester publishes on the request topic of the addressed component**

A component that requests, changes or deletes a resource of another component publishes the request on the Get, Set or Del topic of that resource under the ServiceType and AppId of the addressed component.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Refs: MG 9.1
- Verification: d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1-2a8cc5e7, MG-9.1-478085b5

> In case Service B want to request a specific resource from Service A, Service B must publish on the Get topic of one of Service A’s resources, optionally providing a Filter.
> — MG 9.1

> Service B then must publish on the Del topic of Service A.
> — MG 9.1

Notes: The topic forms are REQ-TOP-013 (matrix); the PublisherId stays the requester's (REQ-MSG-006).

## REQ-BUS-003

**A Get is answered with a Pub**

A component that receives a Get of one of its resources answers it with a publication on the corresponding Pub topic (same Resource, Source and Filter) whose ReplyTo is the MessageId of the Get.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: responder
- Condition: The component supports the resource (area CMP).
- Refs: MG 9.1
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1-c0d352ea

> Service A receives the Get message from Service B through the Message Bus and must reply with a Pub message over the Message Bus.
> — MG 9.1

Notes: ReplyTo per REQ-MSG-015; empty list per REQ-CMP-041; exception Get of Metadata without Data (REQ-CMP-044). The per-resource answers are in the RES-* areas (e.g. REQ-RES-DATA-007, REQ-RES-SUBLIST-008).

## REQ-BUS-004

**A Set carries the updated object on the Set topic**

A component that changes a resource object of another component publishes the complete updated object on the Set topic of that resource, addressing the object with Source and – for resources with a Filter – Filter. Exception: a Set of Config may contain only a part of the Config DataSet (partial update, REQ-RES-CONFIG-003).

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Refs: MG 9.1, SF-081, SF-086
- Verification: d7-validate
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-9.1-224e1dcc, MG-9.1-4a98fe00

> Service B must publish the updated resource object on Service A’s Set topic for this resource (for Config, a partial update is possible, see 9.1.3 Config). Now, Source and – for resources with a Filter – the Filter are required in the topic.
> — MG 9.1

Notes: ReferenceDesignation has no Filter (REQ-TOP-013, MG 7.7; MG 9.1 since SF-081). The per-resource Set payloads are in the RES-* areas (exactly one DataSetMessage, e.g. REQ-RES-DATA-009). The Config exception was added to MG 9.1 with SF-086 (a).

## REQ-BUS-005

**A Del addresses the object with its Filter**

A component that deletes a resource object of another component addresses it on the Del topic with Source and – for resources with a Filter – the Filter of the object.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Refs: MG 9.1, SF-081
- Verification: d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1-b36c6821

> To delete a resource object from Service A, Service B must know the Source and – if the resource has one – the Filter of the resource it aims to delete.
> — MG 9.1

Notes: Del exists for SubscriptionList (with Filter) and ReferenceDesignation (without Filter) only (REQ-TOP-013; MG 9.1 since SF-081).

## REQ-BUS-006

**A successful Set is followed by the publication of the changed object**

After a successful Set, the component publishes the changed object on the Pub topic with the Source and Filter of the Set and the MessageId of the Set as ReplyTo; further publications follow the PublicationList.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: responder
- Condition: The component offers Set for the resource and the Set was successful.
- Refs: MG 9.1
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1-77f75f9b

> In case the Set was successful, Service A must publish the changed resource on the Pub topic in regard to the settings in PublicationList.
> — MG 9.1

Notes: Interpretation of "in regard to the settings in PublicationList" as in REQ-RES-PUBLIST-025 and REQ-RES-REFDES-010 (reviewed in C-027); per resource REQ-RES-DATA-012, REQ-RES-META-007, REQ-RES-SUBLIST-014, REQ-RES-CONFIG-022.

## REQ-BUS-007

**Nothing is published after the deletion of a whole object**

After a Del that removed the whole object addressed by Source and Filter, the component publishes nothing on the Pub topic of that object (the Status event is published on the Event topic).

- Keyword: MUST NOT
- Levels: L1 MUST NOT · L2 MUST NOT · L3 MUST NOT
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: responder
- Condition: The component offers Del for the resource and the Del removed the whole object.
- Refs: MG 9.1, SF-080
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1-43ac5b14

> If the whole Filter has been deleted, Service A must not publish anything on the topic of the resource.
> — MG 9.1

Notes: A Del of ReferenceDesignation always deletes the whole object (REQ-RES-REFDES-007); for SubscriptionList see REQ-RES-SUBLIST-015 (MG 9.1.9 since SF-080 (d)).

## REQ-BUS-008

**A partial deletion is followed by the publication of the changed resource**

After a Del that removed only a part of the objects addressed by Source and Filter (e.g. one subscription out of the SubscriptionList), the component publishes the changed resource on the Pub topic with the MessageId of the Del as ReplyTo.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: responder
- Condition: The component offers Del for the resource and the Del removed only a part of the addressed objects.
- Refs: MG 9.1, SF-080
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1-da721bd7

> In case the Del has deleted only parts of a Filter (e.g., a single subscription out of the SubscriptionList), this is a change to Service A and it must publish the changed resource on the Pub topic regarding to the settings in PublicationList.
> — MG 9.1

Notes: Per resource REQ-RES-SUBLIST-015 (MG 9.1.9 since SF-080 (d)).

## REQ-BUS-009

**Use-case-specific reactions beyond the Status event**

Beyond the Status event, a component reacts to a Set or Del use-case-specifically and, if necessary, publishes further Events (e.g. Syslog).

- Keyword: SHOULD
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 SHOULD
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Refs: MG 9.1
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1-bb0018bd

> Beyond that, the application should react use case-specific and, if necessary, initiate further events and/or syslog entries.
> — MG 9.1

## REQ-BUS-010

**DataSetMessage header of Set and Del requests**

A DataSetMessage (or DataSetMetaData) in a Set or Del request carries the DataSetWriterId of the addressed DataSet as published by the addressed component (for PublicationList and SubscriptionList the common DataSetWriterId of the list), the Source of the topic as DataSetWriterName and the Filter of the topic as WriterGroupName (an empty string for resources without Filter); it carries no SequenceNumber.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Refs: MG 8.2.3, MG 9.1, SF-079
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.2.3-00dee0fa

> In a Set or Del request, the DataSetMessage carries the DataSetWriterId of the addressed DataSet as published by the addressed application (for PublicationList and SubscriptionList the common DataSetWriterId of the list), the Source of the topic as DataSetWriterName and the Filter of the topic as WriterGroupName (an empty string for resources without Filter); it carries no SequenceNumber.
> — MG 8.2.3

Notes: Stated in MG 8.2.3 since SF-079; the examples (MG B1.1.4, B1.1.5, B1.1.8, B1.1.9, B1.1.10) follow it. Since the C-028 review the statement includes "no SequenceNumber" and the empty WriterGroupName (hence draft); the payload checker reports a SequenceNumber in a Set or Del request. The DataSetWriterId of the addressed DataSet is only known to the test against the addressed component (d7-validate).
